## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
git rev-parse HEAD
git status --short
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm run test:editorial
corepack pnpm run test:editorial-lint
corepack pnpm run test:editorial:e2e
corepack pnpm run test:e2e
corepack pnpm --filter @african-mandate/web run build
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 build/AFRICAN_MANDATE_PROMPTBOOK_v2/prompts/24_UI_EDITORIAL_QA.md).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
(Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 apps/web/src/test-map-document-artifact.json).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 docs/build/screenshots/24/*.png
git diff --check
git diff --stat
```

Pass means the frozen install/build exit 0; focused editorial/static/browser suites pass; the complete browser, CI and governance suites pass; hashes match this handoff/README; screenshot inspection shows no lost content; paths match; and Prompt 24 remains `READY_FOR_REVIEW` with no approval metadata. Human review rows remain pending or blocked until named reviewers add dated evidence.

## Diff summary

Prompt 24 adds an executable TEST_ONLY editorial contract without promoting synthetic copy. It inventories every narrative fallback outcome, lints player-facing copy and markers, validates token/component usage, records human-only approvals fail-closed, renders dates through a locale formatter, and measures three major surfaces at the minimum viewport with 200% text. Keyboard, reduced-motion, axe and offline browser paths are pinned. Human regional, legal, publication, cold-read and assistive-technology reviews remain visible and unclaimed.
